acceptance_criteria: The implementation preserves the owner-approved Phase 2 platformer greybox scope.
The player starts on the left and can reach a clear right-side goal before the timer expires.
The controller uses collision-aware platformer movement with gravity, floor/obstacle collision, horizontal acceleration/friction, and fixed-height single jump.
The jump is allowed only from floor contact; no double jump, wall jump, dash, coyote time, jump buffer, or variable jump height is introduced.
The scene uses placeholder geometry only and keeps player, floor, obstacle, goal, and timer visually distinct.
No final art, generated assets, imported sprites, enemies, items, scoring, camera polish, web export, schema/profile changes, or Learning Card promotion are introduced.
scripts/smoke_test.sh passes and emits no SCRIPT ERROR or ERROR output.
The implementation Run record validates and records changed-file scope, verification evidence, and any risks.
The result is handed off to QA for independent review before Phase 2 implementation pass is claimed.
notes: This Work Package authorizes the Phase 2 platformer greybox implementation only. It does not authorize QA self-review, final art, broader gameplay features, project.godot input-map changes, or Godot .uid sidecar policy changes. If implementation requires game/project.godot or game/scripts/*.gd.uid changes, stop and request a scope/policy decision.
